Experience the epic grandeur of Kaun Hain Voh from Baahubali in stunning 8K — a powerful ode to the divine presence, strength, and magnificence of Lord Shiva.
Song - Kaun Hain Voh
Music - MM Kreem
Lyrics - Manoj Muntashir
Singers - Kailash Kher & Mounima
Lyrics:
Jata Kataha Hasambhramabrama Nilimpa
Nirjhari Vilolavi Chivallari Virajamana Murdhani
